scope: Independent visual review of six flagged hunter videos using selected actual decoded contact frames and12 consecutive-frame windows per action. Automatic decoding is separate from visual review.

reviewed_actions.name: 堆雪人
reviewed_actions.observation: Right hand remains on snowman while a second right forearm/hand appears toward snowball. Snowman and snowball also overlap translucently; abrupt upper hand disappearance at477→478.
reviewed_actions.recommended_fix: Needs explicit hand/prop correspondence or additional matched poses; not fixed-master idle substitution.
reviewed_actions.not_claimed: All600 video frames visually inspected or AIRI live playback.

reviewed_actions.name: 被落叶淹没
reviewed_actions.observation: Hands on leaf pile coexist with new raised palms; armor emerges through leaf layer before hand anatomy resolves. More than two hand silhouettes, especially325.
reviewed_actions.recommended_fix: Needs leaf occlusion layer and continuous matched arm path.
reviewed_actions.not_claimed: All600 video frames visually inspected or AIRI live playback.

reviewed_actions.name: 舞狮头
reviewed_actions.observation: Two lion props occupy upper and chest positions simultaneously; smiling closed-eye and open-eye faces overlap; original raised arms persist as holding-front pose appears.
reviewed_actions.recommended_fix: Needs rigid prop path plus hand/arm correspondence; cannot approve as ordinary blur.
reviewed_actions.not_claimed: All600 video frames visually inspected or AIRI live playback.

reviewed_actions.name: 变鸽子
reviewed_actions.observation: At49..53 old lowered hands fade while new chest fists appear. No clear body-position teleport at51; centroid threshold responds strongly to effect/alpha area. Bird/human dissolve123/192 is an intentional transformed-form transition and reviewed separately.
reviewed_actions.recommended_fix: Repair human neutral→casting arm transition; retain explicit transformed-form exception, do not treat centroid flag alone as anatomical jump.
reviewed_actions.not_claimed: All600 video frames visually inspected or AIRI live playback.

reviewed_actions.name: 原地小憩沉眠
reviewed_actions.observation: Prone clasped hands/armor dissolve into a frontal torso while lying hair/bow persists; bow and chest appear in two incompatible orientations during recovery.
reviewed_actions.recommended_fix: Use full locomotion-sleep start/rest/recovery bridge, keep10s action identity.
reviewed_actions.not_claimed: All600 video frames visually inspected or AIRI live playback.

reviewed_actions.name: 点击回应-开心跃动
reviewed_actions.observation: Two lower chest fists persist while two raised fists appear; four hand silhouettes and ghosted forearms during takeoff.
reviewed_actions.recommended_fix: Route all8 classes to a dedicated10s fixed-master three-hop click response, not aliasing the8s happy jump.
reviewed_actions.not_claimed: All600 video frames visually inspected or AIRI live playback.
